The '''Ktil system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Ktilac Regions/Legends|Ktilac Regions]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ktil/Legends|Ktil]], homeworld of the [[Ktilac]] species.
